perps.pro_positions_panel.card.close.where: Each button is about 114px, with about 70px for text. Limit: 10 characters (agreed Nov 2).

perps.pro_positions_panel.card.reverse.where: The longest are Russian Реверсировать and Turkish Tersine Çevir, 13 characters each, both over the limit.

perps.pro_positions_panel.card.share.where: Portuguese Compartilhar (12) and Greek Κοινοποίηση (11) are over 10. German Schließen (9) is the longest Close and fits.

perps.position.card.post_to_feed.where: At most 20 characters. If a translation doesn't fit, fall back to "Post". There is no German translation yet.
